Cache

Cache, a Utah big game hunt unit: Deer, Moose. Utah DWR's boundary description for each 2026 hunt list that names this unit, with the unit's 2026 seasons and hunts as Ranger Hawk reads them from UDWR's hunt lists, the 2026 Big Game Field Regulations and the 2026 Big Game Application Guidebook, as of noon, October 29, 2026.

Cache

Deer · Moose

Box Elder, Cache, Rich and Weber counties—Boundary begins at I-15 and the Utah-Idaho state line; south on I-15 to US-91; east on US-91 to US-89/91; north on US-89/91 to SR-101; east on SR-101 to Hardware Ranch and USFS Road 054 (Ant Flat road); south on USFS Road 054 to SR-39; east on SR-39 to SR-16 in Woodruff; southeast on SR-16 to the Utah-Wyoming state line; north along this state line to the Utah-Idaho state line; west along this state line to I-15. Excludes all CWMUs. USGS 1:100,000 Maps: Tremonton, Logan, Ogden. Boundary questions? Call the Ogden office, 801-476-2740. - A hunting permit does not authorize the permit holder to hunt on Native American trust lands, CWMUs (unless you specifically have a permit for that CWMU) or on National Park lands. Furthermore, it is the responsibility of hunters to learn if hunting is allowed and what specific rules and regulations may apply on National Monuments, National Wildlife Refuges, State Parks, UDWR Wildlife and Waterfowl Management areas, military installations and within the boundaries of cities, towns and municipalities. Written permission is required to hunt private lands.

Other units named Cache: Cache, Crawford Mtn Open unit; Cache, East Rich Open unit; Cache, Meadowville Open unit; Cache, North Open unit; Cache, Rich Open unit; Cache, South Open unit; Cache, Wellsville Open unit

Deer
General Season
General buck deer, archery - CacheAug 15, 2026 to Sep 11, 2026. Drawn with preference points (most units draw at 0-1 point). Extended archery Sep 12, 2026 to Nov 30, 2026 on the Wasatch Front and others.
General buck deer, restricted muzzleloader - CacheSep 23, 2026 to Oct 1, 2026. Restricted-weapons hunt on this unit: restricted muzzleloader equipment only, no scopes of any kind (Field Regulations pages 31 and 45). Drawn with preference points.
General buck deer, restricted rifle - CacheOct 17, 2026 to Oct 25, 2026. Restricted-weapons hunt on this unit: restricted rifle equipment only, no scopes of any kind (Field Regulations pages 31 and 45). Drawn with preference points.
